nodes.summary: The digamma function $\psi = \Gamma'/\Gamma$, where $\Gamma$ is the complex Gamma function, is complex analytic at every $w \in \mathbb{C}$ that is not a nonpositive integer.
nodes.title: Analyticity of the digamma function

nodes.summary: The complex Gamma function is analytic at every $w \in \mathbb{C}$ that is not a nonpositive integer.
nodes.title: Analyticity of the Gamma function

nodes.summary: For every real $y > 0$, the second derivative of $\log \Gamma$ at $y + 1$ equals $\sum_{j=0}^{\infty} \frac{1}{(y + j + 1)^2}$, where $\Gamma$ is the real Gamma function.
nodes.title: Trigamma series

nodes.summary: For every real $t > 0$, the derivative of the complex Gamma function at $t$ equals the derivative of the real Gamma function at $t$.
nodes.title: Complex and real derivatives of Gamma agree on the positive reals

nodes.summary: For every real $u > 0$, the derivative of $\log \Gamma$ at $u$ equals $\Gamma'(u) / \Gamma(u)$, where $\Gamma$ is the real Gamma function.
nodes.title: Logarithmic derivative of the real Gamma function

nodes.summary: For $s \in \mathbb{C}$, the digamma series function at $s$ is $\sum_{j=0}^{\infty} \left(\frac{1}{j+1} - \frac{1}{j+s}\right)$, the sum of the terms of the complex digamma series at $s$.
nodes.title: Complex digamma series

nodes.summary: For $j \in \mathbb{N}$ and $s \in \mathbb{C}$, the $j$-th term of the complex digamma series at $s$ is $\frac{1}{j+1} - \frac{1}{j+s}$, where $1/0$ is read as $0$.
nodes.title: Terms of the complex digamma series

nodes.summary: For every real $y > 0$, the real function $z \mapsto \sum_{j=0}^{\infty} \left(\frac{1}{j+1} - \frac{1}{z+j+1}\right)$ is differentiable at $y$ with derivative $\sum_{j=0}^{\infty} \frac{1}{(y+j+1)^2}$.
nodes.title: Derivative of the digamma series

nodes.summary: For every complex number $s$ with $\operatorname{Re} s > 1$, the series $\sum_{j=0}^{\infty} \left(\frac{1}{j+1} - \frac{1}{j+s}\right)$ of the terms of the complex digamma series at $s$ has sum $\psi(s) + \gamma$, where $\psi = \Gamma'/\Gamma$ is the complex digamma function, the logarithmic derivative of the complex Gamma function, and $\gamma$ is the Euler–Mascheroni constant.
nodes.title: Series expansion of the complex digamma function

nodes.summary: For every real $x > 0$, the series $\sum_{j=0}^{\infty} \left(\frac{1}{j+1} - \frac{1}{x+j+1}\right)$ has sum $\psi(x+1) + \gamma$, where $\psi = (\log \Gamma)'$ with $\Gamma$ the real Gamma function, and $\gamma$ is the Euler–Mascheroni constant.
nodes.title: Digamma series on the positive reals

nodes.summary: For every complex number $s$ with $\operatorname{Re} s > 1$, the sequence of digamma series terms $\frac{1}{j+1} - \frac{1}{j+s}$, for $j = 0, 1, 2, \dots$, is summable.
nodes.title: Summability of the digamma series terms

nodes.summary: For every complex number $z$, the series $\sum_{k \ge 0} \frac{1}{(z + k + 1)^2}$ converges absolutely, that is, the series of absolute values $\sum_{k \ge 0} \left|\frac{1}{(z + k + 1)^2}\right|$ is summable, where a term whose denominator vanishes is read as $0$.
nodes.title: Absolute convergence of the trigamma series

nodes.summary: The series of real numbers $\sum_{j \ge 0} \frac{1}{(j+1)^2}$ is summable.
nodes.title: Summability of the Basel series

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
